o.text: Ultimately from Proto-Mongolic *kaïčï; compare Mongolian хайч (xaič), Bashkir ҡайсы (qaysı).
Izafet III compound of qanun + alilik. Calque of Russian верхове́нство зако́на (verxovénstvo zakóna).
Borrowed from Arabic رَوَاج (rawāj), from Middle Persian [script needed] (lwʾk' /⁠ravāg⁠/, “going”).
